about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Complete car care with attention to appearance, technical condition and every detail.
about.description: We treat a car as a whole system. What matters to us is not only the shine of the paint or a clean cabin, but the overall feel of the car — how it looks, how it comes across and what condition it is in. Detailing, basic mechanics and software work let us approach the job more broadly than a standard car care studio. We do not work fast and loose — we work carefully, step by step, with a clear idea of what a genuinely strong result should be.

faq.title: Answers to the questions that come up most before a visit
faq.subtitle: We have gathered the essentials so it is easier to understand how we work, how long things take and what each service covers.
faq.description: We work across the board — from detailing and paintwork protection through to basic mechanics and ECU / TCU solutions. Below are the questions that come up most often before booking.

q1.question: How long does a service take?
q1.answer: It depends on the scope of work and the condition of the car. Individual services such as basic interior detailing, an oil change or diagnostics can take a few hours. More involved work — paint correction, full detailing, extended mechanical work or a combined service — can take a full day or longer. We confirm the exact time once we have assessed the car and agreed the scope.

q2.question: Do I need to book in advance?
q2.answer: Yes, booking ahead is strongly preferred. It lets us plan the time, prepare the right materials and work out a suitable scope for your car without rushing. This applies to detailing as much as to mechanical work or ECU / TCU solutions.

q3.question: Can I order a single service rather than a full package?
q3.answer: Yes. There is no need to take a ready-made package if you only want one particular result or service. You can book interior detailing, paint correction, headlight restoration, rain repellent for the glass, basic mechanical servicing or a specific ECU / TCU solution on its own.

q4.question: What is the difference between paint correction and a protective coating?
q4.answer: Paint correction improves the surface itself — it removes light scratches, signs of use and holograms, and brings back colour depth and gloss. A protective coating or wax is applied afterwards and helps the car stay clean, water-repellent and fresh-looking for longer. They are separate stages that complement each other well.

q5.question: How long do protective coatings last?
q5.answer: Durability depends on the type of protection, how the car is used and how it is cared for afterwards. Hard ceramic wax gives seasonal protection, while more advanced coatings — carbon, ceramic or graphene — last noticeably longer. For each service we help choose an option to match the effect you expect and your budget.

q6.question: Do you also handle mechanics and ECU / TCU work?
q6.answer: Yes. Alongside detailing we offer basic mechanical servicing, including oil and filter changes, suspension diagnostics and individual mechanical jobs. We also work with ECU / TCU solutions such as Stage 1 and specific modifications like EGR / DPF / AdBlue / Eco Off. The scope and the result depend on the particular model, engine and configuration.
